$comment: Every entry here was read off the programme's own page, not copied from a list.
Each `evidence` item carries the verbatim quote and the URL it came from.
Where a widely-shared list said something the official page does not, that is
recorded in `corrections` rather than quietly fixed — the correction is the
most useful thing on the row.
`status` is computed against `checked`, not asserted forever:
opens-later  cycle closed, next window known or estimated
paused       the programme itself is not running
check-source something material could not be verified from the public page
Anything I could not verify is null with a note. Nothing here is inferred.

eligibilityRules is a machine-readable restatement of the `eligibility` and `restrictions` prose already on each entry, so the browser can check a visitor's profile against it. It adds no new claim. An absent rule means the programme does not state one — which is not the same as saying you qualify.

opportunities.name: Visiting Student Research Program (VSRP)
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate students in 3rd year or above and master's students. Current PhD candidates, KAUST students and KAUST alumni are ineligible.

evidence.quote: USD $1000 Monthly Stipend
Minimum GPA: 3.5/4
All year round

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list gives the duration as 3–6 months. The page says 2–6 months. That list also omits the minimum GPA of 3.5/4, which is the single most decisive line on the page.

opportunities.name: Research Internship Program
opportunities.org: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)

funding.housing: Furnished accommodation on or off campus, funded by OIST or the research unit

opportunities.deadlineText: Four rounds a year: 15 Sep, 15 Nov, 28 Feb, 31 May
opportunities.eligibility: Not stated on the programme description page.

evidence.quote: 2,400 JPY per working day
Furnished accommodation on or off campus, funded by OIST or the research unit
One direct round-trip air ticket

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list says '2 to 6 months' and 'held twice a year'. OIST states 4–6 months and runs four application rounds a year. If you planned for a 2-month placement you would not be eligible.

opportunities.name: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship (SSRF)
opportunities.org: ETH Zurich, Department of Computer Science

funding.travel: Travel and visa expenses covered, claimed against receipts

opportunities.deadlineText: Window ran 1 Nov – 16 Dec for the previous cycle; expect the same shape
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in computer science or a closely related field (electrical engineering, mathematics, physics). Open worldwide except students enrolled at ETH Zurich.
opportunities.restrictions: Students already enrolled at ETH Zurich are excluded.

evidence.quote: Fellows will receive a stipend of CHF 4,000 to cover housing and living expenses.
Travel and visa expenses will be covered as well. Students can claim the travel costs against receipts at the beginning of the programme.
1st November – 16 December 2025 at 13:00 (Central European Time)

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list says 'CHF 4,000 monthly allowance'. The page says 'a stipend of CHF 4,000' with no per-month wording, for a two-month fellowship. Treat the total as CHF 4,000 unless ETH tells you otherwise — the difference is CHF 4,000.

opportunities.name: Excellence in Engineering (E3) Summer Internship

funding.stipend: Monthly living allowance — no figure published

opportunities.eligibility: Bachelor's and master's students who have completed at least their second year of bachelor's studies at the time of application. PhD students are not eligible.

evidence.quote: You will receive a monthly allowance for the entire duration of the internship to cover accomodation and living costs in Switzerland.
8 to 12 weeks during the summer months

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list gives the stipend as '~CHF 1,800'. EPFL publishes no figure anywhere on the programme pages. Do not budget against that number.

opportunities.name: Summer Student Programme

funding.stipend: CHF 94 per calendar day (net subsistence allowance)
funding.travel: Travel expenses to and/or from Geneva, depending on circumstances
funding.insurance: CERN health insurance scheme; contribution deducted from the allowance

opportunities.deadlineText: Applications close end of January each year — confirm the exact date on careers.cern
opportunities.eligibility: Completed at least 6 semesters of full-time university studies in physics, engineering, computer science or mathematics. All nationalities may apply.

evidence.quote: A 94 CHF per calendar day net subsistence allowance
completed at least 6 semesters of full-time university studies in one of these fields
all nationals are welcome to apply

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list says only 'daily allowance'. The figure is CHF 94 per calendar day, and the health-insurance contribution comes out of it rather than being additional.

opportunities.name: ISTernship Summer Program
opportunities.org: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

funding.travel: Lump sum based on distance travelled

opportunities.deadlineText: Not running in 2026. 2027 cycle information expected late 2026.
opportunities.eligibility: Current students and recent graduates with bachelor's or master's degrees from the natural sciences, mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry and related interdisciplinary areas. Must have completed at least the second year / fourth semester of bachelor's studies before the start date.
opportunities.restrictions: The programme is suspended for the 2026 cycle.

evidence.quote: The ISTernship program has been paused for the 2026 application cycle, and the program will not be taking place in 2026.
In 2025, ISTerns received a monthly fellowship payment of 1.150 Euros to cover basic living expenses.

opportunities.corrections: This is the important one. A widely-shared list presents ISTernship as an open opportunity. ISTA's own page states the programme is paused and will not run in 2026. Anyone preparing an application for it is preparing for nothing.

opportunities.name: Research Internship Program
opportunities.org: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems (MPI-SWS)

funding.travel: Travel to and from the hosting institute covered

opportunities.deadlineText: Not published on the pages checked — confirm on the institute site
opportunities.eligibility: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral students worldwide with roughly the first three years of a standard CS bachelor's completed by the start of the internship.

evidence.quote: All interns receive a monthly stipend, free (shared) housing, and travel to and from the institute hosting the internship.
A typical internship lasts 12 to 14 weeks, but longer internships are possible.

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list gives '~€900 – €1,200'. MPI-SWS publishes no figure. Marked check-source because the deadline could not be verified either.

opportunities.name: TIGP International Internship Program (IIP)

funding.housing: On-campus accommodation arranged at a subsidised price
funding.travel: Half of the cheapest economy round-trip airfare

opportunities.deadlineText: Window ran 15 Dec – 15 Jan for the previous cycle; expect the same shape
opportunities.eligibility: Holders of, or students working toward, a BSc or master's degree. PhD students are not eligible, nor are previous TIIP participants or current Academia Sinica employees and research assistants.

evidence.quote: NTD 30,000/month stipend (before tax) and half of the cheapest route round-trip airfare of an economy class

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list implies full travel coverage. Academia Sinica covers half the airfare, and the stipend is quoted before tax.

opportunities.name: UTRIP — Research Internship Program
opportunities.org: University of Tokyo, Graduate School of Science

funding.stipend: GSS-UTRIP Scholarship — stipend, amount not published

opportunities.deadlineText: Window ran 25 Nov – 7 Jan for the previous cycle; expect the same shape
opportunities.eligibility: Enrolled in the second or a later year at an accredited college or university outside Japan, majoring in a natural science or related field.
opportunities.restrictions: Graduate School of Science only — physics, astronomy, chemistry, earth & planetary science, biological sciences.

evidence.quote: renowned faculty members in the GSS's five departments of physics, astronomy, chemistry, earth & planetary science, and biological sciences
currently enrolled in the second or a later year at an accredited college or university outside of Japan, and who are majoring in a natural science or related field

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list advertises UTRIP for 'Data Science, Bio-IT, Computer Science'. UTRIP sits in the Graduate School of Science, whose five departments contain no computer science department. A CS student applying here is applying to the wrong programme.

opportunities.name: India Connect@NTU Research Internship

funding.housing: On-campus accommodation allocated to successful applicants
funding.visa: Training Employment Pass required, obtained by the applicant

opportunities.deadlineText: Not published on the pages checked
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduates in electrical engineering, physics, biomedical engineering, optics or related fields. Two academic referee letters plus a recommendation letter required.
opportunities.restrictions: The programme NTU publishes under this name is India Connect@NTU. Confirm directly with indiaconnect@ntu.edu.sg whether applicants outside India are eligible before investing time in an application.

evidence.quote: Students studying for an undergraduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Optics, or related fields can apply for this program.
fulfil a minimum of 2 months research attachment

opportunities.corrections: A widely-shared list bills this as a general 'NTU Summer Research Internship' with no nationality caveat. The programme NTU actually runs under that description is India Connect@NTU. If you are not an Indian national, verify eligibility before applying — this is the entry most likely to waste your time.

eligibilityRules.nationalityNote: NTU publishes this as India Connect@NTU. Confirm eligibility if you are not an Indian national.

opportunities.name: ELLIS PhD Program
opportunities.org: European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems
opportunities.duration: Full PhD, co-supervised across two European institutions

funding.stipend: Funded through the host institution; EU Horizon / ELIAS grant support

opportunities.deadlineText: Next call expected October 2026; previous deadline was 31 October
opportunities.eligibility: Exceptional PhD candidates in machine learning and related areas. Recommendation letters must be requested through the portal before the application deadline.

evidence.quote: The next call for applications is expected to open in October 2026
funding from the European Union's Horizon research and innovation programme under ELIAS grant agreement number 101120237

opportunities.name: MSc and PhD full scholarship
opportunities.org: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

funding.travel: One return airfare each year to the home country
funding.insurance: Health insurance for the approved funding period
funding.visa: University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID, where eligible

opportunities.deadlineText: Admission rounds published on the admissions pages — confirm the current one
opportunities.eligibility: MSc and PhD applicants. PhD Year 1 is centrally funded while matching with a faculty advisor. MSc is fee-paying by default and not automatically funded. The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI) is fee-based and not eligible for any University or faculty funding.
opportunities.restrictions: MSc funding is not guaranteed — students without a funding source are classified as fee-paying. MAAI is excluded entirely.

evidence.quote: free tuition fees; a monthly stipend; one return airfare each year to their home country; health insurance for the approved funding period; and University-sponsored UAE residence visa and Emirates ID (where eligible).
Year 1 funding: Not automatically funded, fee-paying by default; however, merit-based funding may be available
Guarantee of funding: Not guaranteed for all admitted students; students without a funding source are classified as fee-paying
Year 1 funding: Centrally funded by the University while matching with a faculty advisor
The Master in Applied Artificial Intelligence (MAAI) is a fee-based program; it is not eligible for University or faculty-sponsored funding.

opportunities.corrections: MBZUAI is described almost everywhere as 'fully funded for all admitted students'. Its own admissions page says otherwise: the MSc is fee-paying by default and funding is 'not guaranteed for all admitted students'. Only the PhD is centrally funded in Year 1, and that continues only on a confirmed advisor match. Third-party blogs also quote a monthly stipend figure; MBZUAI publishes none, and two of those blogs contradict each other. Apply with the expectation that MSc funding is competitive, not automatic.

opportunities.name: Supervised Program for Alignment Research (SPAR)
opportunities.eligibility: Open to applicants with a relevant technical background, including undergraduates. No GPA requirement stated.

evidence.quote: Deadline recorded as 18 August 2026 by an agent run against the live page on 2026-08-09, and flagged for manual confirmation.

opportunities.corrections: Remote and unfunded, so it costs travel money and visa risk of zero. It is also the only row on this page closing within a month.
